title: Direct JSON control-character escapes
impact: Replaces `json_write_string`'s `snprintf("\\u%04x")` fallback for unnamed control bytes with direct `\\u00XX` emission from a small hex table. Focused `select_bytes_text_string_reserve.dart` A/B adds a control-character TEXT lane and reproduces the target win across the order flip: 35927 -> 6371 us/query (-82.3%) and 35824 -> 6370 us/query (-82.2%). Safe ASCII, named escaped text, mixed rows, and narrow rows stay as guards; JSON bytes and public API are unchanged.
